DIAGNOSIS READY: Hypoxic-Ischemic Encephalopathy (HIE) with secondary seizures.

The clinical picture of lethargy, hypotonia, irregular respirations, and a tense fontanelle in a 3-day-old neonate is classic for HIE. While the external input mentions pneumonia, the neurological signs you described are more consistent with perinatal asphyxia and brain injury. I will review the lactate, arterial blood gas, and ammonia results to confirm metabolic derangements and rule out other causes like sepsis or organic acidemia.
